notes: Extracted directly from the supplied ROM binary.
Every learnset entry includes type, category, power, accuracy, PP, priority and description.
power=0 means no normal fixed base power; this includes status moves and moves whose damage/power is handled specially.
accuracy=0 means no normal percentage accuracy check; the move may be always-hit, non-damaging, or use special battle logic.
effectId and targetId are preserved in the top-level moves table as raw engine IDs.
